component_name.description: Name of the symbol to manage parameters for

filepath.description: Path to the Altium SchLib file

hidden.description: Whether the parameter is hidden (optional for set, add)

operation.description: Operation to perform: list (all parameters), get (single parameter), set (update value), add (new parameter), delete (remove parameter)

param_type.description: Parameter type (0=String, 1=Boolean, 2=Integer, 3=Float) (optional for set, add). Default: 0

parameter_name.description: Name of the parameter (required for get, set, add, delete)

read_only_state.description: Read-only state (0=editable, 1=read-only) (optional for set, add). Default: 0

unique_id.description: 8-char Altium unique ID (optional for set, add). Default: auto-generated

x.description: X position in schematic units (optional for add)

y.description: Y position in schematic units (optional for add)
